# Feature: Local API loopback

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #20 -->

## Intent
The dashboard must not be controllable from a foreign website (EDGE-011, NFR-005). Fastify binds loopback only, uses a random port and a per-process run token, and has no permissive CORS. REST starts/reads runs; SSE streams phases (CON-004/006).

## Preconditions
- Quick Scan runner exists (#18)
- Canonical error envelope exists in schemas (#4)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Server binds `127.0.0.1` (not `0.0.0.0`) and requires the run token for mutating and run-read endpoints
- [ ] Same-origin request with token can `POST /api/v1/runs` (202) and `GET /api/v1/runs/:id`
- [ ] `POST /api/v1/runs` is idempotent per `Idempotency-Key` (CON-006)
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Cross-origin `Origin` is rejected with 403 even when the token is present
- [ ] Missing token is 401
- [ ] Occupied preferred port → bind a free loopback port and return the URL (EDGE-003)
- [ ] SSE `Last-Event-ID` resumes; reconnect after the stream completed is 410

## Regression
- [ ] No dashboard React UI in this slice
- [ ] No TLS, no cloud auth
- [ ] Scope: `packages/local-api/**` — no `apps/dashboard` components

## Assumptions
- Non-browser clients without `Origin` are allowed when `Host` is loopback and the token is valid
- Run execution is an in-memory stub; wiring `runQuickScan` is a later slice

## Security Coverage
- F-01: waived for loopback-only (AGENTS.md)
- F-04 analog: Origin/Host check, no permissive CORS
- B-03: unauthenticated run control forbidden (401)
- F-03: token is per-process memory, not written to artifacts or localStorage
- P-02: errors do not include the token or stack traces
- P-05: N/A for loopback MVP (single local user)

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- `packages/local-api`: Fastify binds `127.0.0.1` (port 0 or a free fallback). Per-process `base64url` token compared with `timingSafeEqual`.
- Origin/Host must be loopback; OPTIONS/CORS preflight is 403. Missing token is 401. Foreign Origin is 403 even with a token.
- `POST /api/v1/runs` requires `Idempotency-Key` (202 replay, 409 on payload mismatch). SSE resumes via `Last-Event-ID`; completed stream reconnect is 410.
- Run execution is an in-memory stub (no dashboard UI).

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: authenticated same-origin POST → run record → GET/SSE consumers.
- Missing token/origin fail closed (401/403). No queue fan-out.
